title: Dyeing Machine
description: The Dyeing Machine can be used to dye the enchantment glow of items & the items themselves. The coloring of the enchantment glow should work for any item. Block items cannot be put into the machine. Put the item into the left slot and a dye into the right one; the result slots give the dyed item or the item with a dyed enchantment glow. If you wanna remove the dye from an item just put it into the left slot without putting a dye into the right one. Armor can also be dyed and will also be colored when worn.
